bank_book.rationale: Reuse the finite bank P/B screening band; regulatory capital, sustainable ROE and cost of equity remain unreviewed, so this is not residual income.

layered_book.rationale: Reuse the finite holding/resource-asset P/B screening band; no peer calibration, proven reserve appraisal or attributable SOTP is implied.

operating_book.rationale: Reuse the finite operating-company P/B screen while cash-flow, lease, financing and normalization bridges are incomplete; not an FCFF result.

CSB.route_reason: A bank requires sustainable residual income and a cost-of-equity capital bridge; book is only a separate screen.
CSB.intrinsic_blocker: Regulatory capital, normalized ROE, cost of equity and common-only claims have not been reconciled.
CSB.source_warning: The PSE parent-equity field is zero; PHP1.466bn total equity is an explicitly labeled proxy. Reported PHP8.66 BVPS does not exactly equal total equity divided by 173.865m outstanding shares, so the denominator and claims need review.

ORE.route_reason: Mining interests require asset-life and attributable SOTP analysis; book is not a reserve valuation.
ORE.intrinsic_blocker: Economic reserves, permits, production costs, funding and minority claims are not independently underwritten.
ORE.source_warning: FY2025 and 1H2026 parent results were losses; PHP7.055bn parent book is not recoverable reserve value. Printed BVPS differs modestly from parent equity per outstanding share.

ECVC.route_reason: Resource and investment interests require attributable SOTP; total book is only a tentative common-share screen.
ECVC.intrinsic_blocker: Parent attribution, asset rights and the large listed-versus-outstanding share difference remain unresolved.
ECVC.source_warning: The 1H2026 parent-equity field is zero, and FY2025 parent equity exceeds reported total equity; these fields are not treated as a reliable parent-common bridge. PHP1.290bn total equity / 6.63bn outstanding shares is a Low-reliability proxy, not an appraisal.

GREEN.route_reason: Distinct investments require attributable asset and claims analysis; parent book is a separate screen.
GREEN.intrinsic_blocker: Investment fair values, cash realizability, subsidiary debt and minority claims are not underwritten.
GREEN.source_warning: PSE printed PHP0.62 BVPS does not reconcile to PHP1.751bn parent equity / 4.151bn outstanding shares; 1H2026 revenue is much lower than the prior half. The screen uses the explicit parent/share bridge.

EGRN.issuer_name: Everwoods Green Resources and Holdings, Inc.
EGRN.route_reason: Land and investment interests require attributable SOTP; parent book is a finite screening input.
EGRN.intrinsic_blocker: Asset realizability, rights, financing and parent-only capital claims have not been appraised.
EGRN.source_warning: The interim retained-earnings presentation differs sharply from the FY2025 line; no recurring earnings or asset fair value is inferred. Twenty-five billion outstanding common shares are used, not a rounded BVPS.

ENEX.route_reason: Exploration and energy interests require finite-life, risked asset DCF/SOTP; book is only a screen.
ENEX.intrinsic_blocker: Commercial reserves, permits, development funding and project ownership are not independently supported.
ENEX.source_warning: The PSE summary reports no revenue and a large FY2025 loss; the small positive 1H2026 parent book does not establish an economically viable producing asset.

JAS.route_reason: A sustainable operating-cash-flow bridge is needed for FCFF; total book is only a tentative screen.
JAS.intrinsic_blocker: Parent attribution, normalized margins, cash conversion, capital expenditure and financing are not reconciled.
JAS.source_warning: The PSE parent-equity field is blank. PHP180.651m total equity / 250.059m outstanding shares is an explicitly labeled proxy; 1H2026 parent income is also unavailable.

NI.route_reason: Mineral interests require reserve, license and attributable asset-life analysis; parent book is a separate screen.
NI.intrinsic_blocker: Recoverable reserves, license terms, production plan and required financing are not underwritten.
NI.source_warning: FY2025 and 1H2026 gross revenue are zero; PHP239.459m parent book is not a proven-mineral reserve value. Only 600m of 1.01bn outstanding shares appear listed.

WIN.route_reason: Normalized operating cash flows and capital needs must support FCFF; parent book is a separate screen.
WIN.intrinsic_blocker: Declining sales, margins, working capital, capital expenditure and asset realizability are not underwritten.
WIN.source_warning: 1H2026 revenue fell versus 1H2025 and parent income was negative; book value is not a sustainable FCFF estimate.

PA.route_reason: Investment interests require attributable SOTP; book per common share is only a screen.
PA.intrinsic_blocker: Investment realizability, future business funding and parent-only claims are not reconciled.
PA.source_warning: The PSE summary reports no FY2025 or 1H2026 revenue and continuing losses; positive book value is not evidence of recurring cash generation.
